coordinate.basis: navigation distanceMetric from the shared 2F-10F corridor survey

legacyFloor4Survey.formula: right corridor + half core wall-center width
legacyFloor4Survey.limitation: Adopted by explicit user confirmation; GLB-derived reference.

extraction.calibration: first 8 steps estimate a constant offset against the absolute training grid near the known start
extraction.intermediateTruth: linear detected-step progress between confirmed endpoints

variants.e0: 8-step magnitude session templates, current thresholds, 25% accepted correction
variants.e2: 0.5m 1D absolute grid HMM using start-calibrated magnitude
variants.e3: E2 plus start-calibrated vertical magnetic component

limitations: Intermediate truth is endpoint-aligned detected-step progress, not surveyed foot position.
Confirmed endpoint error is stronger evidence than intermediate trajectory error.
All sessions are the same user; platform-specific grids are evaluated separately.
m_v uses a causal accelerometer-vector EMA because TYPE_GRAVITY was not recorded.
Thresholds and grid-filter constants were fixed before examining this run and were not tuned on held-out folds.
The candidate grid is an offline review artifact and is not loaded by the app.
